purpose: Standard SAP Logical Databases (LDB) mapped to UNESCO's domains. LDBs encode SAP's native ECC hierarchical table model (header->item, based on foreign keys). This is the target list + interpretation guide for extract_ddic_model.py (LDBN/LDBS) and the source of the standard hierarchy for domain_data_model.json.
how_to_read: An LDB = tree of table-nodes + GET<table> events delivering rows in tree order (GET BKPF -> GET BSEG). Node join = the tables' foreign key. 3 parts: structure (tree, in LDBS/LDBN) + selections (screen) + program SAPDB<name>. CAUTION: some LDBs model header+item at the SAME level with a join (BRF: BKPF & BSEG), not strict parent-child -> read the real LDBN tree, do not assume.
status: RESEARCHED_PENDING_VALIDATION (P01/D01 down; root tables + programs from SAP docs/knowledge, validate against LDBN/LDBS on first extraction)

funds_management_model.note: FM has NO single classic LDB like BRF. It is accessed via FI-FM integration: the control number CTRNR is processable in programs AND logical databases, and FM line items bridge to FI via FMIFIIT.KNBELNR=BKPF.BELNR (+KNGJAHR, +KNBUZEI line-level). The model below is the authoritative FM structure (validate keys against DD03L on first extraction).

actuals_lines.meaning: Actuals FI-FM line items (WRTTP filter mandatory)

avc_totals.meaning: Availability Control totals (rebuilt from FMIT via FMAF)

funds_management_model.brain_relevance: Largest PSM area: FM-AVC model gap (MODEL-GAP-2026-001), 2,005 buckets at risk, fmavct_*, the AVC derivation. The FM model + hierarchies are central to that analysis.
